lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings — Buildings A through E3, all new construction in an Accommodations 2 zone. Also worth watching: Thursday's joint Planning Commission and BOCC work session takes up proposed Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those changes gets worked out.
